name: verify_productCategory_audit_columns_by_id
note: product_category: create/write uid and date per row (mail/chatter and the record's metadata read), keyed by id
source_sql: SELECT id, create_uid, write_uid, create_date, write_date FROM product_category ORDER BY id

name: verify_productCategory_scalar_listing
note: product_category: every int/string/bool column of every row as a list view reads it, keyed by id
source_sql: SELECT id, parent_id, company_id, parent_path, removal_strategy_id, packaging_reserve_method FROM product_category ORDER BY id

name: verify_productCategory_embed_fanout_by_parent
note: product_category: per-parent count of each embedded array (product_category_stock_picking_type_rel) against the child-row count, keyed by id
source_sql: SELECT r.id, COALESCE(e0.n, 0) AS n_stockpickingtyperel FROM product_category r LEFT JOIN (SELECT product_category_id AS pid, COUNT(*) AS n FROM product_category_stock_picking_type_rel GROUP BY product_category_id) e0 ON e0.pid = r.id ORDER BY r.id
